name: SPECIALIZATION IN FRENCH STUDIES
title: SPECIALIZATION IN FRENCH STUDIES English, French and Writing

sections.heading: SPECIALIZATION IN FRENCH STUDIES
lines: Completion of first-year requirements, including French 1900E or French 1910 or French 1999 with a mark of at least 60%, or permission of the Department.
1.0 course: French 2905A/B and French 2906A/B (or French 2900), OR French 2805A/B and French 2806A/B (or former French 2800).
2.0 courses in French at the level above 3500 and below 3799.
3.5 courses in French at the 2200 level or above (with a maximum of 1.0 course at the 2000 level).
